items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he cursed out Jimmy Lyons of the Monterey Jazz Festival.

ctx.x: They played a lot of great music as well as a lot of funny music. They “Cocktails for Two” and Mingus would have us play that with the whole band sometimes, “Cocktails for Two.” “When The Saints Go Marching In,” we played. When we couldn’t play all of the music that we had together at Monterey, they kicked us off after…I don’t know, 25 minutes or something. Mingus was pissed so he had us play “When The Saints Go Marching In” and we marched around the stage, and marched off the stage and he cursed out Jimmy Lyons…
Now where were we with Mingus? How long were you with Mingus?
